# SOD1 outcome-blind independent cohort candidate

Purpose: qualify Axakova et al. 2025 SOD1 DMS as a possible replacement for GFP in the original four-family M17 confirmation. Preserve M17/M18.x hypothesis, 3/4 directional denominator, model grids, test labels blinded, and historical artifacts. Do not train or use scores until formal admission.

## Verified primary metadata (2026-10-19)
- MaveDB experiment https://mavedb.org/experiments/urn:mavedb:00001217-a
- Abundance score set urn:mavedb:00001217-a-3, 2906 variants, VAMP-seq in HEK293.
- Activity score set urn:mavedb:00001217-a-4, 2910 variants, yeast functional selection.
- Exact target reference from record: MATKAVCVLKGDGPVQGIINFEQKESNGPVKVWGSIKGLTEGLHGFHVHEFGDNTAGCTSAGPHFNPLSRKHGGPKDEERHVGDLGNVTADKDGVADVSIEDSVISLSGDHCIIGRTLVVHEKADDLGKGGNEESTKTGNAGSRLACGVIGIAQ (154 residues including initiator Met).
- Primary paper https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajhg.2025.08.019 ; https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12696502/
- Experimental WT structural candidate PDB 2C9V https://www.rcsb.org/structure/2C9V; atom-resolution X-ray Cu/Zn SOD1, potential 153-aa mature vs 154-aa assay offset. Met/construct/chain/metallation/disulfide details must be verified rather than guessed.
- MaveDB shows 'No special data usage policies', which is not an explicit redistribution license. Resolve item terms, paper supplement coverage and derived model/metric permission separately.
- 2026 BEBlab SOD1-ddPCA https://github.com/BEBlab/SOD1-ddPCA is a distinct assay publication and *not* to be mixed with 2025 labels.

## Admission tasks
1. Download only metadata, source/reference structure and genotype/mutation identifier columns, preserve score-column blindness. Trace data S2/MaveDB score-column lineage, sample IDs, reference coordinates, censoring/replicate metadata from methods and schema only. Create source/checksum manifest without phenotype decoding.
2. Align exact assay target to experimental 2C9V chain(s), audit initiator Met, coordinate coverage, WT and possible metal/oxidation context. Run strict full-reference then prospective masked-reference admission only if justified, not synthetic WT substitutions.
3. Profile/Pfam and sequence-similarity audit against all M0–M18 historical reference sequences and other external candidates; retain original thresholds, ambiguous flags and limits. Document SOD1 prior PyMOL study as personal prior biological familiarity, not a supervised benchmark.
4. Evaluate whether SOD1 abundance/activity is comparable under assay-local Spearman to CspA/CI2/TEM1 and how selection of one outcome is preregistered before test-label access.
5. Verify dataset-specific legal reuse, redistribution, research/prediction/weights terms. No blanket extrapolation from public download access or software MIT.
6. If all gates pass, issue explicit prospective manifest and matched four-family fold plan, preserving original directional criterion and controls. Do not evaluate if CspA/CI2 license remains blocked, or if SOD1 mapping remains unqualified.
7. Tests, Ruff, current branch CI, candidate admission report; no added model architecture, no release tag.

Outcome now: METADATA PASS; dataset admission PENDING. No supervised predictions run.
title: SOD1: Blinded external-family dataset and structural admission audit
